businesses.business: industrial process fluids and specialty chemicals

offering_description.value: Develops, makes and sells industrial process fluids and specialty chemical products such as rolling lubricants, metalworking fluids, coatings, cleaners and corrosion preventives. Customers are metals producers, automotive and other manufacturers. Sells mostly directly with on-site technical support and chemical management.

primary_products.value: metalworking fluids; rolling lubricants; industrial coatings; corrosion preventives; hydraulic fluids

primary_services.value: fluid management; on-site technical support; chemical management

customer_segment.value: B2B: steel and aluminum producers, automotive and aerospace manufacturers, machining and metal parts makers, mining and can makers

end_markets.value: steel; aluminum; automotive; aerospace; metal fabrication; mining; can manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: specialty chemicals and process fluids sold to industrial customers; service fees: fluid management and chemical management services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: blends purchased raw chemicals and oils into process fluids sold to industrial manufacturers; service provider: on-site fluid management for customer plants

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific, with operations in many countries

specialization.value: related lines: process fluids, coatings, specialty chemicals and fluid management services for industrial customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: technical sales staff selling to industrial plants; distributors / dealers: distributors serving smaller customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: chemical regulations such as REACH, TSCA and OSHA workplace and environmental rules
